# Incident Response

## Suspicious Service Installation (PsExec-style / Command Services)

**Technique:** [T1569.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1569/002/) · **Rule:** [`T1569.002_suspicious_service_installation`](../T1569.002_suspicious_service_installation/)

| Role | Action |
|---|---|
| SOC L2 | Find the network logon (4624 type 3) and share access (5140/5145) just before the 7045 to identify the source host |
| Incident response | Collect the service binary, delete the service, and investigate the source host as compromised |

### Evidence to collect
- 7045 event
- Preceding 4624 type 3 and 5140/5145 share access
- Service binary before it is deleted
- Source host of the network logon

### Containment
1. Collect the service binary
2. Delete the service
3. Treat the source host as compromised and investigate it
